reason: The screen-signature runtime injection was published successfully but still did not render on the user's installed app screen. Replace screen matching with a root-mounted control that does not depend on TradeTab, BotTab, ScrollView signatures, card text, or active-trade state.

required_checks: A permanent red EXIT button renders at bottom-right after app unlock
Button is visible on Home, Trade, Bot, Tools and Account screens
Pressing EXIT opens a full-screen open-trades list
Every open trade receives a separate selected-trade exit action
Manual exit sends only the selected trade_id
No automatic strategy or execution rule changes
JavaScript checks and Android Metro export
validation.root_cause: Runtime screen detection remained dependent on the final rendered JSX tree. A root-mounted overlay is independent of all screen/card matching and therefore provides a deterministic visible control.
validation.ui_fix: Mount GlobalManualExitOverlayV6 in index.js around the entire app. Show a permanent bottom-right red EXIT button with an open-position count badge and a modal containing per-trade exits.
validation.data_behavior: Open trades refresh from trade history, trade-live and bot signal payloads. Selected trade exit uses its exact id.

trade_safety: Explicit user-requested manual exit UI only. No signal, score, entry, automatic exit, quantity, stop-loss, cooldown, capital allocation, broker or order-placement rule changes.
